nodes.label: CHIMERA: A Knowledge Base of Scientific Idea Recombinations
nodes.author: Noy Sternlicht, Tom Hope
nodes.rationale: First large-scale KB of recombination examples from scientific literature, enables analysis of cross-disciplinary ideation and training of hypothesis generation models

nodes.label: Idea Recombination
nodes.rationale: Creation of novel ideas by integrating elements from existing concepts; includes blends and inspirations

nodes.label: Concept Blend
nodes.rationale: Fusion of multiple concepts into a new solution or framework

nodes.label: Inspiration Transfer
nodes.rationale: Transfer of knowledge or insight from one entity (source) to another (target) through analogies or abstraction

nodes.label: CHIMERA Knowledge Base
nodes.author: Sternlicht & Hope, 2025
nodes.rationale: Large-scale KB of 28K+ recombination examples extracted from scientific literature with blend and inspiration relations

nodes.label: Information Extraction for Recombinations
nodes.rationale: NLP task of identifying and extracting recombination instances from scientific abstracts

nodes.label: Meta-Scientific Analysis
nodes.rationale: Empirical study of how innovation unfolds through analysis of recombination patterns across domains

nodes.label: Scientific Hypothesis Generation
nodes.rationale: Training models to propose novel research directions by learning from patterns of past recombinations

nodes.label: Inspirations Cross Domains, Blends Within Domains
nodes.rationale: Inspirations span broader range of domains while blends tend to link within same or similar domains

nodes.label: Robotics Draws Inspiration from Zoology
nodes.rationale: Cross-domain inspiration pattern showing robotics frequently inspired by zoological concepts

nodes.label: CHIMERA: Knowledge Graph of Scientific Idea Recombination
nodes.author: Multiple authors (Chan, Hope, Shahaf, Kittur et al.)
nodes.rationale: Large-scale knowledge graph extraction system designed to capture scientific idea recombination patterns from research papers, enabling analysis of how researchers combine and draw inspiration from existing concepts.

nodes.label: Recombination Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Specialized information extraction method designed to identify and classify two types of scientific recombination: blends (combining multiple ideas) and inspirations (drawing from one domain to apply in another).

nodes.label: Blend Recombination Type
nodes.rationale: Recombination where authors combine two or more ideas, methods, models, or techniques to achieve a goal; represents fusion of multiple concepts into new solutions.

nodes.label: Inspiration Recombination Type
nodes.rationale: Recombination where authors draw inspiration or similarities from one concept/domain and implement it in another; captures cross-domain knowledge transfer.

nodes.label: End-to-End Recombination Extraction
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuned LLM approach (Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) that performs simultaneous classification, entity extraction, and relation inference for recombination identification.

nodes.label: GoLLIE Information Extraction Model
nodes.rationale: General IE model fine-tuned to follow annotation guidelines in zero-shot fashion; tested as baseline for recombination extraction using data class definitions.

nodes.label: Entity Normalization Process
nodes.rationale: Multi-step process including abbreviation expansion via regex and scispacy, followed by agglomerative clustering with cosine similarity to group semantically equivalent entities.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Construction
nodes.rationale: Process of building graph nodes from extracted entities, assigning scientific domains via GPT-4o, normalizing entities, and postprocessing with LLM refinement.

nodes.label: Scientific Domain Classification
nodes.rationale: Zero-shot classification of entities into arXiv categories or broader scientific branches; includes domain grouping to address sparsity in non-arXiv fields.

nodes.label: Recombination Prediction Task
nodes.rationale: Bi-encoder architecture task that predicts novel recombination inspirations given a query context; uses contrastive learning with RankGPT reranking.

nodes.label: Context Extraction for Queries
nodes.rationale: GPT-4o-mini extraction of background/motivation sentences from abstracts to create specific query contexts; includes leak detection filtering.

nodes.label: User Study Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Human evaluation of model-predicted recombination suggestions by NLP researchers; assesses helpfulness for research ideation and novelty of cross-domain inspirations.

nodes.label: Mistral-7B Fine-tuning for Extraction
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuning approach using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) on single GPU; implements end-to-end recombination extraction with 500 training steps.

nodes.label: GPT-4o Reranking for Predictions
nodes.rationale: RankGPT-based reranking of top-20 predictions using GPT-4o; improves recombination prediction accuracy through multi-turn ranking dialogue.

nodes.label: Span Similarity Evaluation
nodes.rationale: GPT-4o-mini based evaluation determining if two extracted spans discuss same entity; uses bidirectional querying to mitigate position bias.

nodes.label: Large-Scale Extraction Assessment
nodes.rationale: GPT-4.1 based LLM judge validation on 2000 automatically extracted examples; achieves 80.55% estimated extraction accuracy with F1 score of 0.912.

nodes.label: Solvent: Ideation Support System
nodes.rationale: Prior work on supporting creative ideation through analogical search; foundational for CHIMERA's approach to research idea generation.

nodes.label: Structure-Mapping Theory of Analogy
nodes.rationale: Theoretical framework for understanding analogical reasoning; foundational for conceptualizing inspiration-based recombination.

nodes.label: Accelerating Innovation Through Analogy Mining
nodes.rationale: Prior work on mining analogies from scientific literature to accelerate innovation; directly related to CHIMERA's recombination prediction task.

nodes.label: Atypical Combinations and Scientific Impact
nodes.rationale: Empirical study showing atypical combinations of research contents are related to scientific impact; motivates focus on cross-domain recombinations.

nodes.label: SciREx: Document-Level Information Extraction
nodes.rationale: Challenge dataset for document-level information extraction from scientific papers; related baseline for recombination extraction evaluation.

nodes.label: Multi-Task Entity, Relation, and Coreference Extraction
nodes.rationale: Multi-task IE approach for scientific knowledge graph construction; related methodology for entity and relation extraction.
